3) Locate Grand Total

- The section shows:
  - "Auftragssumme 23,46"
  - "MWSt-Basis 1 23,46 MWSt 10,00 2,35"
  - Then "Endbetrag EUR 25,81"

6) Consistency checks and alternatives
- Could "Auftragssumme 23,46" be after discount? There is also "Grundrabatt 3,00 % 0,73 -" listed. The line items: price 24,19, minus discount 0,73 gives 23,46 which matches "Auftragssumme". So Net.Amount=23.46 is consistent.
- Total: 23.46 + 2.35 = 25.81 matches Endbetrag. Good.

7) Missing or multiple occurrences
- Only one VAT group present. No exchange rates. All required fields found.
- Ensure no inference beyond visible data.

Conclusion: extract Invoice.Date = "2024-01-29", GrandTotal.Amount = 25.81, Sender.VatId = "ATU31800708", Vat.Rate = 10, Net.Amount = 23.46, Vat.Amount = 2.35.
